Sarah, Tom,

Draft disclosure list attached (16 documents at this stage), mapped to the Issues for Disclosure. I've flagged the Wraysbury report and the 4 June internal note as privileged - grateful for a check on the latter, which is borderline (it records reliance on Calderhall's qualification, arguably litigation-adjacent advice). Disclosure is due 12 December.

Elena

Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP

messages.plaintextBody:
Good. On the 4 June note - if it records advice obtained or our client's litigation thinking, claim privilege; if it's just a commercial record of the procurement decision, it's disclosable. Please review the full text and we'll decide. Otherwise content to proceed.

Sarah
